FULL TEXT:
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
1 |5 P a g e
INFORMATION -BROCHURE FOR 1st SLST(NTS) FOR GROUP-C
AND GROUP-D
HOW TO APPLY
Online submission process
a) At first eligible incumbents should visit the official website of the School Service
Commission www.westbengalssc.com, where he/she has to provide all the required
information as asked for.
b) Click on Register Button -> 1st SLST(NTS) 2025 Registration. The One Time
Registration Form will appear. Please keep your basic details ready with you.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
2 |5 P a g e
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
3 |5 P a g e
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
4 |5 P a g e
In this Form All Fields are mandatory. Enter your name, Parent’s Name, Category,
Gender, DOB, Email Address, Mobile Number, Religion, Address details and a Strong
Password.
c) After Successfully registering your primary details, you will be redirected to a
Dashboard where you will find your Auto-Generated Candidate ID. Please keep this
Candidate ID Safely. All future correspondence will done using this Candidate ID.
To complete your application process you need to fulfill the following five requirements
(All links are available in Dashboard) :
i) Photo Upload (Size : between 30KB and 60KB Type : JPG)
ii) Email Verification ( Email OTP will be sent to your registered Email Address)
iii) Mobile Verification (Mobile OTP will be sent to your registered Mobile Number)
iv) Profile Completion (During Registration you have already provided some information)
v) Payment (Through Billdesk/Easebuzz)
Note : Please enter own email address and mobile number.
d) Login Page
If you want to complete the Total Application Process with your comfort of time, then you
can logout and when you will again come back then use the login window for entering
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
5 |5 P a g e
into your dashboard.
Note : You can login using Candidate ID, Email or Mobile and Password.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
6 |5 P a g e
e) Dashboard :
A welcome pop-up message will come. Please record your auto-generated Candidate ID
and Click ‘Got It’.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
7 |5 P a g e
f) Upload Photo (Step-1, Green Box) :
Click on the button ‘Uplaod Photo’. The following page will come.
After Uplaoding an image file a preview will be shown as follows :
Click on Back to Dashboard. You will see the Photo in the Profile section.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
8 |5 P a g e
Note : You can change your photo, if required till finalization of your profile.
g) Email Verification (Step-2, Yellow Box) :
Click on the Verify Button available in the yellow box. A verify form will appear. An email
shall have also been sent to your registered email address. Check your inbox (Also your
spam folder, if not found in inbox) for Email OTP and enter it in the following input field
and click Verify :
After successfully entering email OTP, your email address will be Verified. You will be
redireced to Dashboard again :
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
9 |5 P a g e
h) Mobile Verification (Step-3, Red Box) : This process is also similar to that of Email
Verification. But this time the Mobile OTP will be sent to your registered Mobile Number.
After entering correct OTP you have to click on Verify Button. You will be redirected to
Dashboard.
i) Profile Completion (Step-4, Blue Box) : Please keep your educational qualification
related testimonials ready in this step. Click on Complete Profile Button. A Profile
Completion form will appear. Here, Three tabs will be loaded i) Personal Information. ii)
Education iii) Review & Submit.
The information in the First screen will be pre-filled as these were already entered by you
during Registration. However, you can change the information (Except Name and
Parent’s Name), if required till the finalization of profile.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
10 |5 P a g e
If no change required, just view it and proceed to next tab by clicking on Next Button.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
11 |5 P a g e
Please fill in your academic details in the above form. Only the academic qualification of
Madhyamik (10th Level) is required for the Post of Group-C. If you are applying for the
Post of Group-D, then you may leave this step and just click on Next. Additional
Qualification is Optional.
The incumbents whose marks are awarded according to Grading System, can uncheck
the checkbox. By unchecking the checkbox, the form will allow the percentage to be
entered manually.
After entering the mandatory information as per required eligibility criteria, click on Next
button.
The third tab is for Review and Submit.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
12 |5 P a g e
Click on the Button Submit Profile Form. If successully submitted the following
confirmatory page will appear :
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
13 |5 P a g e
Now your Profile is Complete. If, there is still to be edited some fields/items you can do
that by clicking on the Edit option beside the Profile creation (In Activity Column
available in Dashboard). When you are ready to finalize your profile, just click on the
Button ‘Finalize your Profile’.
Before Finalization, if may see your profile from Profile section. (Link available in the left
menu).
Note : After finalization of Profile, you shall not be able to edit your profile, under any
circunstances.
j) Application for the Post of Non_Teaching Staff (Step-5, Black Box) :
Click on the Button ‘Apply Now’.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
14 |5 P a g e
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
15 |5 P a g e
Fill in the required fields and Click Submit Application. Make sure, vacancy exists as per
your choice of Region appying for, Medium of Instruction appying for, your category and
gender.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
16 |5 P a g e
By Clicking on the Button, Back to Dashboard you will be redirected to Dashboard.
k) Payment (Step-6, Sky Blue Box) :
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
17 |5 P a g e
Click on the Pay Now Button from the Recent Activity panel. You will have the options
two Payment Gateways (BillDesk/ Easebuzz) to select for payment. Click on the Button
after selecting your prefered Gateway. This will redirect you to a Payment Review form.
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
18 |5 P a g e
Verify the records displayed in the Review Payment Page. After being sure, Click on the
Pay Button. It will redirect you to a secured payment gateway (Billdesk/Easebuzz).
Pay Application Fees through: Debit/ Credit card, Net Banking and UPI : following
the link applicant will be directed to the concerned banking website where he/she has to
provide “debit /credit card number” , “Card valid through date”, “CVV” for Debit/
Credit Card , “User Name” and “Password” for net banking and all UPI Payment Apps and
to follow the instructions. After successful payment the page will automatically re-
directed to the Commission’s website (Do not Press Back/Refresh Button during
Payment Process) and one can print the payment receipt instantly.
Billdesk Payment Page
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
19 |5 P a g e
Easebuzz Payment Page
1ST SLST(NTS) for Group-C and Group-D 2025
20 |5 P a g e
The candidates are NOT required to send hard copy of confirmation page to School
Service Commission. However, the candidates are advised to retain the hard copy of the
application form. The particulars once filled by the candidate shall be final and will not
be changed in future.
The Commission will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of non-
acceptance of any correction/addition/deletion in any particular once filled in the
Application Form whatsoever the reasons may be.
Commission shall not charge any extra amount except the fees mentioned in the
Notification. However, bank charges may apply.
